items.title: The dimension of every component of an intersection of equidimensional closed subsets of affine space is at least r plus s minus n
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the expected dimension bound for the intersection of an r-dimensional and an s-dimensional equidimensional closed subset of affine n-space. The proof introduces the product X times Y inside affine 2n-space with coordinates x_i and y_i, realizes X cap Y as the intersection of the product with the linear subspace V(x_1 - y_1, ..., x_n - y_n), and at a closed point t of the intersection computes dim(O_{X times Y, t}) = r + s using the dimension of a product together with the local dimension lemma (proof lines 6347-6354). The one-equation dimension lemma over a local ring then gives dim(O_{X cap Y, t}) >= r + s - n, and the local dimension lemma converts this into the statement about irreducible components (proof lines 6355-6362). H2: the product trick and the two dimension comparisons are the substance.
